sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority Mineral Wing Taking Over Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2009
ACT I OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
SARHAD
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
MINERAL WING
(TAKING OVER) ACT,
2009
An Act to provide for the taking over of the
Mineral Wing
of Sarhad Development
Authority by Government of the North-West
Frontier Province and to absorb the employees of the said
wing in the Exploration Promotion Division of the
Directorate General of
Mines and Minerals,
North-West
Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
31st January, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP-Bills/2009/3524, dated
31-1-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority Mineral Wing (Taking-over)
Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on 14th January, 2009 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on 21st January, 2009 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient to provide for the taking-over of the Mineral Wing of Sarhad Development Authority by Government of the
North-West Frontier Province and to absorb the employees of the said wing in
the Exploration Promotion Division of
the Directorate General of Mines and Minerals North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Sarhad
Development Authority Mineral Wing (Taking-Over) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless the context
otherwise requires,---
(a)"Appendix"
means the Appendix to this Act;
(b) "assets"
includes the vehicles, furniture, and other store items specified in Appendix;
(c) "Department" means the
Industries, Commerce, Mineral Development, Labour and
Technical Education Department of Government;
(d) "Government" means the
Government of the North-West Frontier Province;
(e) "Employees" means the employees borne on the Mineral Wing of SDA
immediately before the commencement of this Act;
(f) "Mineral Wing" means the
Mineral Wing of SDA;
(g) "Prescribed" means
prescribed by rules made under this Act; and
(h) "SDA" means Sarhad Development Authority established under section 3
of the Sarhad Development
Authority Act, 1972 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.XI
of 1973).

31-1-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority Mineral Wing (Taking-over)
Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on 14th January, 2009 and assented to by the Governor of the

the Exploration Promotion Division of

Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
5. Absorption of employees.---(1) On
their transfer under section 3, the employees shall stand absorbed in the
Exploration Promotion Division of the Directorate General of Mines and Minerals
of the Department and shall, for all intents and purposes, be deemed to be
civil servants with effect from the date of their appointment:
Provided that their seniority vis- -vis
the employees of the Exploration Promotion Division of the Directorate General
of Mines and Minerals of the Department shall be determined with reference to
regular and continuous date of
appointment of both the employees to the respective cadre/post.
(2) The inter se seniority of the
employees on their absorption shall remain the same as they enjoyed during
their employment under SDA.
(3) The terms and conditions of service
of the employees shall be the same as admissible to the civil servants;
provided that such terms and conditions shall not be less favourable
than those admissible to them under SDA.
(4) The services of employees of
exploration and Mineral Development Department will be transferable to other
Government Departments in the North-West Frontier Province.
